snippet.title: Midnight Special: Official Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
🎮The latest demo of Midnight Special is now free to play on Steam. Early Access coming soon in May!
Wishlist now if you love classic horror games 👉 https://store.steampowered.com/app/2560100?utm_source=youtube 

👩As Sarah, a babysitter hired for a "quiet" gig at a remote estate, your night spirals into chaos. Solve puzzles, evade unspeakable horrors, and survive gunfights to escape a labyrinth where time warps and sanity frays.

- Classic Homage: Channels Clock Tower and Resident Evil with 16-bit pixel art and cinematic psychological tension.
- Point-and-Click Exploration: Scour environments for vital items—every object could save your life.
- Branching Storylines: Unravel the castle’s dark secrets through intertwined main quests and side missions.
- Dynamic Horror: Blurring reality and illusion, your choices shape multiple chilling endings.

🙌Follow Yahaha Games for more updates:
🔹 Official Website: http://www.yahaha.com/publisher
🔹 X/Twitter: https://x.com/Yahaha_Games
🔹 Discord: https://discord.gg/Pf47cTmKZ4
🔹 YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@YahahaGames
